column20: This event was triggered by a utility power sag in the Australia East region
column21: What happened?; prolonged impact, predominantly as a result of dependencies in recovering subsets of Storage, SQL, and/or Cosmos DB services
column22: approximately half of Cosmos DB clusters in the Australia East region were either down or heavily degraded
column23: What happened?; Australia East region, one datacenter, within one of the Availability Zones
column24: there were cases in which all of the copies were unavailable due to failures on multiple impacted storage servers
column25: What went wrong and why?; every DB moved required manual mitigation via scripts
column26: How did we respond?; Voltage sag occurred on utility power line with no central controller or config push implicated
column27: V8b: failed over to their alternate regions to restore availability; V8a and V8c: no statement found
column28: Physical power/cooling failure in one Australia East datacenter; blast radius coded single_region as the widest scope named, and multi-region failover worked only for eligible Cosmos DB accounts.
